entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please hold for the next available agent.
I need to make a return. Just connect me to someone.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Charlie. I can help you with that. May I have your name and order number, please?
Alex Rodriguez. Order is 775-B. Look, I just need a return label. Can you email it to me so I can get on with my day?

Of course, Alex. Pulling up your order now... I see the VeloBand GPS Tracker, the Pulse model. To ensure I process this correctly, can I ask what specifically is the issue with it? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
There's no fault. I just changed my mind. It was an impulse buy and frankly, I just don't use it. Just send the label.

I understand. Thank you for clarifying. Looking at the delivery date, I see the band arrived 15 days ago. For the VeloBand Pulse specifically, due to how it activates and syncs personal data, we have a strict 10-day window for returns based on preference. Because of that, I'm unable to process a refund for this item.
Wait, what? Ten days? Are you serious? I don't have time to deal with complicated policies. So you're telling me I'm just stuck with a hundred-and-fifty-dollar paperweight?

I recognize this is frustrating, and I do apologize. While a direct return to us isn't an option, you are definitely not stuck. We recently launched the official VeloFit Resale Marketplace. It's a secure platform where you can sell the band to another VeloFit community member, often for a very good price.
A resale marketplace? So I have to do all the work? Why would I do that?

It's a very simple listing process, and it puts you in control of the price. And given your status as a VIP customer, Alex, I can waive the standard seller's commission fee for you. Additionally, once the band sells, I can add a $25 VeloFit credit to your account for any future gear.
No fee and a $25 credit? ...Fine. That's an actual solution. Send me the link to this marketplace. And only the link.

Absolutely. I'm sending that email right now. It will include the direct link and your unique code to waive the fee. The credit will appear automatically after the sale is complete. Was there anything else I could assist with today?
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
